title: Dutchess Tavern, Richard Batiste and what counts as tradition
summary: Allen recalls Frank Murray's band at the Dutchess, Batiste's trumpet trill resembling Bunk, and how traditions start.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Buddy Bolden and Buddy Petit: the trumpet legends
